content: स्थूल {%a.%} (<ab>compar.</ab> स्थवीयस् <ab>superl.</ab> स्थविष्ठ) .²1 Large, great, big, bulky, huge; बहुस्पृशापि स्थूलेन स्थीयते बहिरश्मवत् <ls>Śi. 2. 78</ls> (where it has sense 6 also); स्थूलहस्तावलेपान् <ls>Me. 14</ls>, <ls n="Me.">108</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 28</ls>. .²2 Fat, corpulent, stout. .²3 Strong, powerful; स्थूलं स्थूलं श्वसिति <ls>K.</ls> ‘breathes hard’. .²4 Thick, clumsy. .²5 Gross, coarse, rough (<ab>fig.</ab> also) as in स्थूलमानम् <ab>q. v.</ab> .²6 Foolish, doltish, silly, ignorant. .²7 Stolid, dull, thick-headed. .²8 Not exact. .²9 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) Material (<ab>opp.</ab> to सूक्ष्म). .{@-लः@} The jack tree. .{@-ला@} .²1 Large cardamoms. .²2 Scindaspus Officinalis (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>गजपिंपळी</ns>). .²3 Cucumis Utilissimus (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>थोरकाकडी</ns>). .{@-लम्@} .²1 A heap, quantity. .²2 A tent. .²3 The summit of a mountain (कूट). .²4 Sour milk, curds.
